The user is asking which residue is phosphorylated. Looking at the PDB, I need to find phosphoserine (SEP), phosphothreonine (TPO), or phosphotyrosine (PTR).

Looking at the structure, I see residue "TPO P 3" at atoms 1104-1114. TPO is phosphothreonine. It has a P (phosphorus) atom and O1P, O2P, O3P atoms - clear indication of phosphorylation.

The residue is in chain P, residue number 3, and it's TPO (phosphothreonine), which corresponds to threonine.

The format requested is <chain>:<one-letter amino-acid code><author residue number>. TPO is phosphothreonine, one-letter code T.

So the answer should be P:T3.
